info.title: SWIV Citilink Real-Time Vehicle Locations API
info.description:
Reverse-engineered specification for the public REST backend of Citilink's (Fort Wayne, IN transit) real-time bus tracking web app, built on the Navineo/SWIV AVL (Automatic Vehicle Location) platform by CADAVL. All resources were discovered by capturing the live requests issued by the app's front-end JavaScript (`resources/scripts/scripts_topologie.min.js`) against `https://swiv.citilink.cadavl.com/SWIV/CITILINK/`.

No authentication was required for any endpoint during discovery (no cookie, referer, or API key needed) — this appears to be an intentionally public, read-only data feed powering the embedded transit map. The backend is a Java JAX-RS service (internally mounted at `/jaxrs/SwivWS/`) fronted by a proxy at `/SWIV/CITILINK/proxy/restWS/`.

All responses are served with `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` even though the bodies are JSON — API consumers must parse the body as JSON regardless of the declared content type.

Out of scope: `CITILINK/proxy/geoserver` is referenced in the page's HTML config (`urls.geoserver`) but is never actually called by the front-end JS in the captured session — it appears to be a vestigial WMS map-tile endpoint from the shared Navineo template, not part of the live restWS data API.

servers.description: Citilink (Fort Wayne, IN) production SWIV instance

tags.name: topology
tags.description: Static and near-static route/stop/deviation network data

get.description: Returns the complete topology for the transit center(s) configured for this SWIV instance: all lines (with full itinerary geometry), all stops, and all currently active route deviations. This is the initial full-state load called once on page init (`intialisationSWIV`); subsequent updates are fetched incrementally via `/topo/refresh`. The response can be large (multi-MB) since itinerary geometry is fully denormalized per line.

200.description: Topology snapshot, one entry per transit center ("CE" = Centre d'Exploitation) configured on this SWIV instance. Citilink only has a single CE ("CITILINK").

truncated-live-sample.summary: Truncated live sample (full response ~2MB) — see samples/GET_topo.json

get.description: Polled every `timer.topo` seconds (observed default: 15s) after the initial `/topo` load. Returns only what has changed: active line deviations (as references to already-known `idTroncon` segment IDs rather than full geometry), any newly-added stops/segments not present in the original `/topo` response (under `objetsSuppl`), and updated per-stop route-color associations.

200.description: Incremental topology update, one entry per transit center.

get.description: Polled every `timer.vehicule` seconds (observed default: 10s). Returns the current position and trip state for every active vehicle, optionally filtered to a set of lines.

filtered-by-line.summary: Filtered to a single line via lignes= param — see samples/GET_topo_vehicules_lignesFilter.json

500.description: Internal Server Error — observed when the `lignes` parameter is malformed (e.g. not base64, or not in `libelleCE:mnemo` form).

get.description: Polled every `timer.version` seconds (observed default: 60s) to detect when the server-side topology/config has changed. When the client's cached value of `valeur` for a given `libelleCE` no longer matches the server's, the front-end forces a full page reload to pick up new topology.

"iv" = "info voyageur" (traveler information). Returns active rider-facing service messages (detours, stop closures, etc.), each optionally associated with one or more lines. Rendered in the app's "Public Service Messages" panel.

get.summary: Get upcoming arrivals for a stop
get.description: "pta" = "point d'arrêt" (stop). Returns, for the given stop, the next scheduled/predicted arrival(s) per line/destination serving it. Powers the popup shown when a stop marker is clicked, and is repolled every `timer.horaire` seconds (observed default: 10s) while that popup stays open. Each returned `destination.horaires[].idHoraire` is later used as the `idHoraire` path parameter to `/horaires/horaire/{idPointArret}/{idHoraire}/{direction}` to page forward/backward through additional departures for that destination.

parameters.name: idPointArret
parameters.description: Numeric stop ID, matching `pointArret[].idPointArret` from the `/topo` response.

200.description: List of scheduled/predicted departures grouped by line and destination. Returns `{"listeHoraires": []}` for a stop ID with no upcoming service (including unknown/non-existent stop IDs — this endpoint does not 404 on an unrecognized numeric ID).

unknown-or-no-service.summary: Stop with no upcoming departures — see samples/GET_horaires_pta_unknown_stop_empty_result.json

404.description: Returned when `idPointArret` is not a valid integer (path fails to route in the backend).

get.summary: Page forward/backward through a stop's departures for one destination
get.description: Used by the stop popup's prev/next (◀/▶) arrows to fetch the schedule entry adjacent to `idHoraire` for the given stop, in the given direction. `idHoraire` comes from a `horaires[].idHoraire` value previously returned by `/horaires/pta/{idPointArret}` (or by a prior call to this same endpoint). Response shape mirrors a single element of `listeHoraires` from the `pta` endpoint (i.e. one destination object), not the full `listeHoraires` wrapper.

parameters.name: idHoraire
parameters.description: The schedule entry ID (`horaires[].idHoraire`) to navigate relative to.

parameters.name: direction
parameters.description: Navigation direction. "SUIVANT" = next/following departure, "PRECEDENT" = previous departure.

200.description: Single destination/schedule object for the requested navigation step.

CacheBuster.name: _tmp
CacheBuster.description: Client-side cache-busting timestamp (milliseconds since epoch). Has no observed effect on the response other than defeating HTTP caching; safe to omit.

LignesFilter.name: lignes
LignesFilter.description: Restricts the response to a set of lines. Value is the base64 encoding of one or more `libelleCE:mnemo` pairs joined by `___` (three underscores), e.g. base64("CITILINK:7ANT___CITILINK:4P"). `libelleCE` is the transit center code and `mnemo` is a line's short code (see `ligne.mnemo` in `/topo`). Malformed values have caused HTTP 500 on `/topo/vehicules` during testing — treat this parameter as fragile.

LatLng.description: A geographic point, also used to carry a vehicle heading (`cap`) where relevant.

cap.description: Heading/bearing in degrees (0-359). Always 0 for static topology points; meaningful for vehicle positions.

Troncon.description: A single road/track segment ("tronçon") between two points, the atomic unit of route geometry.

Itineraire.description: One itinerary (path variant) of a line, expressed as an ordered list of road segments.

Ligne.description: A transit line/route, as returned in full-topology and message contexts.

mnemo.description: Short internal route code, e.g. "7ANT". Used to build the `lignes` filter param.

couleur.description: Hex color (e.g. "#1b89ca") used to render this route on the map/UI.

itineraire.description: Full path geometry for this line. Empty array in slimmer contexts (e.g. within `/iv/message`).

messageIVExiste.description: Whether an active service message exists for this line. Observed only as `null` in samples.

InfoLigneSwiv.description: Association between a stop and a line it serves, with optional display metadata. Field set observed to vary by endpoint (e.g. `estPad` in `/topo`, `couleur` in `/topo/refresh`).

estPad.description: Whether this stop is a "PAD" (provisional/temporary stop) for this line. Seen in `/topo`.

couleur.description: Hex color for this line at this stop. Seen in `/topo/refresh`.

Deviation.description: An active route deviation's geometry, as returned in the full `/topo` snapshot.

topo.description: One entry per configured transit center.

IdTronconsGroup.description: A named group of segment IDs referencing geometry already known from a prior `/topo` call.

tronconsDevies.description: Segments of the line's normal itinerary currently being bypassed.

tronconsDeviation.description: Replacement segments forming the detour path.

ObjetsSuppl.description: Newly-introduced geometry/stops not present in the client's original `/topo` load (e.g. a brand-new detour road not part of any known itinerary).

tronconsCommun.description: Segments shared by multiple lines' itineraries.

pointArret.description: Stops with updated line associations (typically just `idPointArret` + `infoLigneSwiv`).

update.description: One entry per configured transit center.

estimationTemps.description: Estimated time to next stop, unit not confirmed from observed data (always 0 in samples).

vitesse.description: Current speed. Unit not confirmed (likely km/h or mph).

avanceRetard.description: Human-readable schedule adherence, e.g. "on time", "13 min late".

vehiculeLoad.description: Passenger load as a display string, e.g. "14%", or null if unavailable.

estAffichable.description: Whether this vehicle should be shown on the map (some vehicles are tracked but hidden, e.g. deadheading).

valeur.description: Opaque monotonically-changing version marker; a change signals the client should reload.

message.description: Rider-facing alert text. May be an empty string.

ligne.description: Lines this message applies to; empty array for a general/system-wide message.

Horaire.description: A single scheduled departure time slot.

idHoraire.description: Opaque ID for this schedule entry; used as the `idHoraire` path param for prev/next navigation.

etatHoraire.description: Schedule status code. Observed value: 1. Exact enum not confirmed from observed data.

etatPassage.description: Passage/real-time status code. Observed values: 0. Client treats `2` as "suppressed" (struck through) and non-`2` as normal.

horaire.description: Predicted/real-time departure time, in seconds since midnight.

horaireApplicable.description: Scheduled (theoretical) departure time, in seconds since midnight. `0` means not applicable.

HoraireDestination.description: Upcoming departures for one line/destination pair at a stop.

destination.description: Present when returned nested under `/horaires/pta/{idPointArret}`'s `listeHoraires[]`. When returned directly by `/horaires/horaire/.../{direction}`, the response IS one destination object (see note).

libelleHexa.description: Hex-encoded ASCII of `libelle`, used internally as a stable key.

existeSuivant.description: Whether a later departure exists to page forward to.

existePrecedent.description: Whether an earlier departure exists to page backward to.

modeManu.description: Whether the client is in manual paging mode for this destination.

horaires.description: Usually 1-2 entries: the current departure and, when present, the one being paged to.

listeHoraires.description: Empty array when the stop has no upcoming service or the stop ID is unrecognized.

ErrorResponse.description: Standard Spring Boot error envelope returned for routing/framework-level errors (unmatched path, malformed path parameter, unhandled server exception).

path.description: Internal backend path, e.g. "/jaxrs/SwivWS/horaires/pta/abc" — reveals the underlying JAX-RS mount point `/jaxrs/SwivWS/` behind the public `/proxy/restWS/` prefix.
